# Polygon clipping runtime dependency

Unmodified polygon-clipping 0.15.7 UMD minified bundle, downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/polygon-clipping@0.15.7/dist/polygon-clipping.umd.min.js .

SHA-256: 7f8619e84a86ce8dd400c9b50430e9c8cf8f26027b19eeb479f109f5c1a9d688

Original project: https://github.com/mfogel/polygon-clipping . The MIT license and bundled dependency licenses are retained alongside the bundle. Source attribution comments embedded in the bundle are preserved. Used only for bounded vector-building residual geometry when displaying geographically placed candidates.

Bundled code notices: splaytree 3.1.2 (Alexander Milevski, MIT); robust-predicates 3.x (public-domain Unlicense); Microsoft TypeScript helper snippet (Apache-2.0 notice retained verbatim, full Apache license included). The splaytree MIT grant is reproduced using the same standard MIT terms because its npm tarball and repository do not contain a separate license file. No source code was modified.
